data.name: provider_display_name
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"} The PowerToys utility's name.

data.name: snippets_title
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"} The Command Palette command and page that list Text Expander's snippets.

data.name: snippets_subtitle
data.value: Search your snippets and paste one

data.name: snippets_page_name
data.comment: Opens the snippets page.

data.name: snippets_placeholder
data.value: Search snippets by trigger or text
data.comment: A trigger is the short text that Text Expander replaces with a snippet.

data.name: answers_unnamed_label
data.comment: Shown for a snippet question that has no words of its own. Text Expander uses the same words.

data.name: answers_required_placeholder
data.comment: Placeholder in a box that must be filled in before the snippet can be pasted.

data.name: answers_optional_placeholder
data.comment: Placeholder in a box that can be left empty.

data.name: tag_asks_questions
data.comment: Tag on a snippet that asks for answers before it's pasted.

data.name: tag_text_expander_only
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"} Tag on a snippet that only Text Expander can insert.

data.name: text_expander_only_name
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"}

data.name: text_expander_only_toast
data.value: Only Text Expander can fill in this snippet. Type its trigger in your app instead.
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"}

data.name: preview_placeholder_format
data.comment: Shown in a snippet preview where text goes in when the snippet runs. {0} is what goes there: a question's words, or "Clipboard", "Link from clipboard" and the like.

data.name: preview_clipboard
data.comment: Shown in a snippet preview, as {0} in "[{0}]", where everything on the clipboard goes.

data.name: preview_clipboard_from_now
data.comment: Shown in a snippet preview for part of what the user copied. {0} is the part, such as "Email" or "Phone number".

data.name: preview_clipboard_from_history
data.comment: Shown in a snippet preview for part of a copy the user picks from clipboard history. {0} is the part, such as "Email" or "Phone number".

data.name: preview_clipboard_whole_history
data.comment: Shown in a snippet preview for a copy the user picks from clipboard history.

data.name: preview_clipboard_email
data.comment: An email address in a copy. Shown as {0} in "{0} from clipboard".

data.name: preview_clipboard_link
data.comment: A web link in a copy. Shown as {0} in "{0} from clipboard".

data.name: preview_clipboard_phone
data.comment: A phone number in a copy. Shown as {0} in "{0} from clipboard".

data.name: preview_clipboard_number
data.comment: A number in a copy. Shown as {0} in "{0} from clipboard".

data.name: empty_off_title
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"}

data.name: empty_off_subtitle
data.value: Turn on Text Expander in PowerToys Settings to paste your snippets here.
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander", "PowerToys"}

data.name: empty_policy_subtitle
data.value: Your organization manages Text Expander, so it can't be turned on here.
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"}

data.name: empty_no_snippets_subtitle
data.value: Add snippets in PowerToys Settings > Text Expander > Manage snippets.
data.comment: {Locked="PowerToys", "Text Expander"} "Manage snippets" is the name of a button on the Text Expander page.

data.name: empty_not_found_subtitle
data.value: There's no snippets file at {0}. Check where it is in PowerToys Settings > Text Expander.
data.comment: {Locked="PowerToys", "Text Expander"} {0} is a file path.

data.name: empty_unreadable_subtitle
data.value: {0} couldn't be opened. If it's on a drive or in a sync folder that isn't ready yet, try again soon.
data.comment: {0} is a file path.

data.name: empty_not_snippets_line_subtitle
data.value: Line {0} of {1} has a mistake. Fix it in Manage snippets or in a text editor.
data.comment: {0} is a line number. {1} is a file path. "Manage snippets" is the name of a button in Text Expander's settings.

data.name: empty_not_snippets_subtitle
data.value: {0} isn't a snippets file. Fix it in Manage snippets or in a text editor.
data.comment: {0} is a file path. "Manage snippets" is the name of a button in Text Expander's settings.

data.name: empty_no_matches_subtitle
data.value: Search for a trigger, or for words in a snippet.

data.name: open_settings_name
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"}

data.name: open_settings_failed_toast
data.comment: {Locked="PowerToys"}

data.name: fallback_display_title
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander"} Names the main-search result that offers a snippet.

data.name: toast_off
data.value: Text Expander is off. Turn it on in PowerToys Settings to paste snippets.
data.comment: {Locked="Text Expander", "PowerToys"}

data.name: toast_no_target
data.value: Couldn't paste the snippet: no app came to the front.

data.name: toast_out_of_reach
data.value: Couldn't paste the snippet: that app runs as administrator.

data.name: toast_target_changed
data.value: Stopped inserting the snippet because another window came to the front.

data.name: toast_terminal_lines
data.value: Couldn't insert this snippet into the terminal: a snippet with more than one line goes in only as a paste, and the clipboard couldn't be used just now.
data.comment: Shown when a snippet with several lines wasn't inserted into a terminal window, such as Windows Terminal. Typing the lines instead would run each one as a command.

data.name: toast_clipboard_not_restored
data.value: Your clipboard couldn't be put back, so the snippet is still on it.

data.name: toast_missing_clipboard
data.value: There's no text on your clipboard, so that spot was left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet that takes what the user copied, when the clipboard held no text. The rest of the snippet was pasted.

data.name: toast_missing_clipboard_several
data.value: There's no text on your clipboard, so those spots were left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet with more than one spot that takes what the user copied, when the clipboard held no text. The rest of the snippet was pasted. Can be shown before another of these sentences, one for each kind of part that wasn't there.

data.name: toast_missing_email
data.value: There's no email address in what you copied, so that spot was left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet that takes an email address from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted.

data.name: toast_missing_email_several
data.value: There's no email address in what you copied, so those spots were left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet with more than one spot that takes an email address from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted. Can be shown after another of these sentences, one for each kind of part that wasn't there.

data.name: toast_missing_link
data.value: There's no link in what you copied, so that spot was left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet that takes a web link from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted.

data.name: toast_missing_link_several
data.value: There's no link in what you copied, so those spots were left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet with more than one spot that takes a web link from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted. Can be shown after another of these sentences, one for each kind of part that wasn't there.

data.name: toast_missing_phone
data.value: There's no phone number in what you copied, so that spot was left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet that takes a phone number from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted.

data.name: toast_missing_phone_several
data.value: There's no phone number in what you copied, so those spots were left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet with more than one spot that takes a phone number from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted. Can be shown after another of these sentences, one for each kind of part that wasn't there.

data.name: toast_missing_number
data.value: There's no number in what you copied, so that spot was left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet that takes a number from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted.

data.name: toast_missing_number_several
data.value: There's no number in what you copied, so those spots were left empty.
data.comment: Shown after pasting a snippet with more than one spot that takes a number from what the user copied, when there wasn't one. The rest of the snippet was pasted. Can be shown after another of these sentences, one for each kind of part that wasn't there.

data.name: picks_title_email
data.value: Pick the email address to insert
data.comment: Search box hint on a page listing the email addresses found in what the user copied. Picking one inserts it into the snippet.

data.name: picks_title_link
data.comment: Search box hint on a page listing the web links found in what the user copied. Picking one inserts it into the snippet.

data.name: picks_title_phone
data.value: Pick the phone number to insert
data.comment: Search box hint on a page listing the phone numbers found in what the user copied. Picking one inserts it into the snippet.

data.name: picks_title_number
data.comment: Search box hint on a page listing the numbers found in what the user copied. Picking one inserts it into the snippet.

data.name: picks_nothing_to_pick
data.value: Nothing to pick. Press Enter to paste.
data.comment: "Enter" means the Enter key on the keyboard. Search box hint on a page showing a snippet as it will be pasted, when what the user copied had one match or none for each part the snippet takes from it.

data.name: picks_comes_out_empty
data.comment: Shown in place of a snippet's text when nothing would be pasted, because what it takes from what the user copied wasn't there.
